bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core
registered="$root/.worktrees/source-import-20261013"
printf 'CORE_HEAD='; git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'REGISTERED_HEAD='; git -C "$registered" rev-parse HEAD
printf 'MODEL_DIR='; realpath "$root/models"
test -d "$root/models"
df -B1 --output=size,avail,target "$root/models"
printf 'MODEL_FILES\n'; find "$root/models" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.gguf' -printf '%f %s\n'
printf 'BACKEND_IMAGES\n'; docker ps -a --filter name=ai-qwen3 --filter name=ai-coder --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}'
printf 'TOOLS\n'; command -v curl; command -v sha256sum
